defaults.rawState: Raw identities include chilled or frozen unprepared products of the named cut/species. Freezing is storage context for these protein identities only, not a change to the approved fresh-produce policy. Thaw frozen raw protein safely before these recipes; availability never depends on temperature, quantity or date.
defaults.cookedState: Fully cooked/ready-to-eat sausage identities are distinct from raw. Smoked, cured, a brand, kielbasa or andouille wording alone never establishes fully cooked state. Raw and fully cooked forms have no compatibility edge.
defaults.evidence: Require named animal/food and cooking state from original observed title or traceable product-label evidence, plus explicit boneless/bone-in qualifiers when the identity requires them. Fresh, value pack, or a store/sausage brand alone is insufficient. A reviewer-confirmed pantry choice does not qualify a quote automatically.
defaults.reject: Reject unresolved alternatives/mixed foods, prepared meals, cooked meat offered as raw, raw sausage offered as fully cooked, breaded/battered/marinated/sauced/seasoned products except the explicitly named sausage preparations, dry/cured chorizo, canned/smoked/cured salmon, whole salmon or salmon steaks offered as fillets, and contradictory cooking-state/animal/cut labels.
defaults.prices: No source portions, bone/skin/trim yield conversions or fixed estimates. Retain observed retail units and history. Apply exact per-recipe offer admission before cheapest-per-store selection; do not price a boneless requirement from a bone-in pack. Broad/ambiguous quotes remain unpriced.
defaults.species: Pork-qualified raw sausages require pork evidence; do not treat chicken/turkey, meat-free or mixed-species sausages as pork. Generic smoked/kielbasa/andouille entries intentionally leave species unspecified and confer no dietary guarantees.

ambiguousTerms.decision: Do not infer bone-in or boneless/skinless. Require traceable cut/bone evidence before an exact counterpart or price.
Do not infer boneless loin. Reject unknown cut/bone state for the named boneless loin-chop identity.

ambiguousTerms.term: pot roast / arm roast / stew meat
ambiguousTerms.decision: Require raw beef evidence. The cooked pot-roast dish is excluded; unspecified raw stew/pot-roast cuts stay separate from boneless chuck and have no current recipe permission.
Cooking state remains unverified without raw/uncooked or fully cooked/ready-to-eat product evidence. Named styles and brands are not cooked-state proof.
Require raw fillet/filet evidence for fillet counterparts. Generic raw fillets do not establish species; do not infer farming method, bonelessness or edible yield.

decisions.rationale: An association identifies a possible food in the existing market group, not ownership, recipe permission or a verified price. Require actual food, material cut/bone qualifiers and cooking-state evidence; preserve original titles/units/store provenance.
